creators.name: Jorge Guevara
creators.role: Dancer, choreographer and researcher of dance in VR
creators.bio: Dancer and choreographer who has spent years improvising with Naoto Hieda in the live-coded Best Practices in Contemporary Dance series. As a fellow of the Akademie für Theater und Digitalität in Dortmund and a researcher at Motion Bank, he studies how an audience can still feel a dancing body when the dance is mediated by VR headsets.
creators.why: He treats the headset as a stage problem, asking how presence and empathy between dancer and audience survive the jump into virtual space.
creators.role_zh: 舞者、编舞，研究 VR 中的舞蹈
creators.bio_zh: 舞者兼编舞，多年来与 Naoto Hieda 合作即兴系列 Best Practices in Contemporary Dance：他跳舞，对方现场编程。他曾在多特蒙德的 Akademie für Theater und Digitalität 担任研究员，也在 Motion Bank 做研究，关注的问题是：当舞蹈要透过 VR 头显观看时，观众还能否感受到舞者的身体。
creators.why_zh: 他把头显当作剧场问题来研究：舞者与观众之间的在场感和共情，怎样才能跟着进入虚拟空间。

creators.name: Aphra Shemza
creators.bio: British artist who makes interactive light sculptures, often from recycled plastic and old light fittings, that respond to how close visitors stand or how much noise they make. Much of her work reinterprets the geometric abstraction of her grandfather, the painter Anwar Jalal Shemza, and she co-created the installation Post Truth and Beauty with Tim Murray-Browne.
creators.why: Her sculptures make the viewer's position and voice the switch, so walking closer or talking becomes the way you read the work.
creators.bio_zh: 英国艺术家，创作互动灯光雕塑，常用回收塑料和旧灯具制作，作品会根据观众站得多近、发出多大声音而变化。她的许多作品重新诠释了祖父、画家 Anwar Jalal Shemza 的几何抽象，并与 Tim Murray-Browne 合作了装置 Post Truth and Beauty。
creators.why_zh: 她让观众的位置和声音成为开关：走近一步或开口说话，就是读懂作品的方式。

creators.name: Lily Hassioti
creators.bio: Greek artist trained in computational arts at Goldsmiths who builds responsive sound installations out of plants, motors, metal sheets and thermal cameras. With Samuele Albani she made Passaggi // Presenze, where people passing through doors and moving through a room compose the sound together.
creators.why: She turns everyday presence, a touch on a leaf, a step into a room, body heat, into sound that visibly depends on you.
creators.bio_zh: 希腊艺术家，在 Goldsmiths 学习计算艺术，用植物、电机、金属板和热成像摄像头搭建会回应人的声音装置。她与 Samuele Albani 合作了 Passaggi // Presenze：人们穿过门、在房间里走动，一起谱出声音。
creators.why_zh: 她把日常的在场——触碰一片叶子、走进房间、身体的热量——变成明显取决于你的声音。

creators.name: Simon East (Curvor / Flowfal)
creators.role: Mobile interaction designer; creator of the Flowfal motion-to-music system
creators.bio: Co-founder of the Leeds-area mobile studio Curvor, where he develops Flowfal, a low-latency system that turns the movement of phones, smartwatches and wands into control of Ableton Live, Max and TouchDesigner. He took part in the 2022 Choreographic Coding Lab at A+E Lab with Rebecca Evans of Pell Ensemble, and Flowfal now drives her motion-activated dance scores.
creators.why: He makes the body a music controller with devices people already wear, so a wrist turn or a raised arm plays and moves sound.
creators.role_zh: 移动交互设计师；Flowfal 动作转音乐系统的开发者
creators.bio_zh: 利兹附近的移动应用工作室 Curvor 联合创始人，开发了 Flowfal：一套低延迟系统，把手机、智能手表和手持棒的动作转换成对 Ableton Live、Max 和 TouchDesigner 的控制。2022 年他与 Pell Ensemble 的 Rebecca Evans 一起参加了 A+E Lab 的 Choreographic Coding Lab，如今 Flowfal 驱动着她由动作触发的舞蹈配乐。
creators.why_zh: 他用人们本来就戴在身上的设备把身体变成乐器：转一下手腕、抬一下手臂，就能演奏并移动声音。

creators.name: Jamie Gledhill
creators.bio: East Anglia artist and lecturer at Norwich University of the Arts whose installations use Kinect, Leap Motion and ordinary webcams for contact-free play, from body-outline projections to an interactive sculpture takeover and an AR trail of talking trees. He was lead artist of The Multitude, Collusion's two-player body-projection game.
creators.why: He designs playful public pieces that coax strangers into moving and playing together, using the simplest body tracking.
creators.role_zh: 视听艺术家、交互设计师
creators.bio_zh: 英国东安格利亚艺术家，任教于 Norwich University of the Arts。他的装置用 Kinect、Leap Motion 和普通摄像头实现无接触的游戏互动，从身体轮廓投影、公共雕塑的互动改造，到会说话的树组成的 AR 路线。他也是 Collusion 双人身体投影游戏 The Multitude 的主创艺术家。
creators.why_zh: 他用最简单的身体追踪做公共作品，引导陌生人一起动起来、一起玩。

creators.name: Uncharted Limbo Collective (George Adamopoulos, Eleana Polychronaki, Chris Waters)
creators.role: Creative coding studio for real-time visuals and performance
creators.bio: Studio of creative coders and visual artists working at the meeting point of code, interactive visuals and the performing arts. They built the motion-responsive visuals for Alexander Whitley's Anti-Body and co-created Chaotic Body and PRE-FIGURES with him, and develop dome and AI co-performer projects such as Protist Reverie and Monolith.
creators.why: They turn captured human motion into physical simulations, fluids, particles and slime-mould growth, that a performer can push around in real time.
creators.role_zh: 做实时视觉与表演的创意编程工作室
creators.bio_zh: 由创意程序员和视觉艺术家组成的工作室，工作在代码、互动视觉与表演艺术的交汇处。他们为 Alexander Whitley 的 Anti-Body 制作了随动作变化的视觉，并与他合作了 Chaotic Body 和 PRE-FIGURES；自己也在做球幕演出 Protist Reverie 和 AI 共演项目 Monolith。
creators.why_zh: 他们把捕捉到的人体动作变成流体、粒子、黏菌生长等物理模拟，让表演者可以实时推动它们。

creators.name: Children of the Light (Christopher Gabriel & Arnout Hulskamp)
creators.bio: Amsterdam duo who use light as their main material across performance, sculpture and immersive installations, from a darkened grid of reflective tubes lit only by visitors' phones to rotating halos and slowly rising lines of light. They made the kinetic light sculpture at the centre of Alexander Whitley's Overflow.
creators.why: They shape how a space feels with the fewest possible elements, often letting the audience's own light or movement complete the piece.
creators.bio_zh: 阿姆斯特丹的艺术二人组，以光为主要材料，创作表演、雕塑和沉浸式装置：有只靠观众手机照亮的反光管阵列，也有旋转的光环和缓缓升降的光线。他们为 Alexander Whitley 的舞作 Overflow 制作了核心的动态灯光雕塑。
creators.why_zh: 他们用尽可能少的元素塑造空间的感受，经常让观众自己的光或动作来完成作品。

creators.name: Holosphere
creators.bio: Birmingham XR studio that builds VR, AR and real-time projection projects, from training simulations to live art. For Birmingham Royal Ballet it created a motion-capture-driven 35-metre backdrop, and it experiments with pose tracking on building facades and real-time mocap imagery in museums.
creators.why: They bring stage-scale motion capture out of the theatre and onto buildings and gallery floors where the public can try it.
creators.bio_zh: 伯明翰的 XR 工作室，做 VR、AR 和实时投影项目，从培训模拟到现场艺术都有。它为 Birmingham Royal Ballet 制作了由动作捕捉驱动的 35 米背景屏，也在尝试把姿态追踪用于建筑立面、把实时动捕影像带进博物馆。
creators.why_zh: 他们把舞台级的动作捕捉带出剧院，搬到建筑外墙和展厅里，让普通观众也能亲手试。

creators.name: Tom Ward
creators.bio: Kent-based digital artist working across 2D and 3D animation, modelling, games and installations, and a freelance creative technologist for Electric Medway since 2024. His AR pieces for Electric Medway fill night-time streets and rooms with glowing plants and deep-sea creatures, and he is adding AR windows to the Intra Stories murals.
creators.why: He uses phone AR to give community festivals a second, glowing layer that local audiences can find in familiar places.
creators.role_zh: 数字艺术家、创意技术人
creators.bio_zh: 肯特郡的数字艺术家，创作涵盖二维与三维动画、建模、游戏和装置，2024 年起担任 Electric Medway 的自由职业创意技术人。他为 Electric Medway 做的 AR 作品让夜晚的街道和房间长满发光植物、游满深海生物；他还在为 Intra Stories 壁画加上 AR 窗口。
creators.why_zh: 他用手机 AR 给社区艺术节加上一层发光的第二现实，让本地观众在熟悉的地方发现它。

works.title: Becoming Performance in VR
works.description: The second research cycle of his Dance in VR fellowship at the Akademie für Theater und Digitalität: a studio showing where a dancer performs while spectators follow the dance through VR headsets, testing whether they can still feel the presence of the digital body.
works.description_zh: 他在 Akademie für Theater und Digitalität 研究项目 Dance in VR 的第二轮成果：舞者在工作室里表演，观众戴着 VR 头显观看，检验他们是否仍能感受到数字身体的存在。
works.idea_en: Ask what a headset audience needs in order to feel a dancer who is only there as data.
works.idea_zh: 追问：戴头显的观众需要什么，才能感受到一个只以数据形式存在的舞者。
works.technique: The dancer's movement is likely captured and streamed into a shared real-time VR scene viewed on standalone headsets, with the same scene projected for the rest of the room.
works.technique_zh: 舞者的动作很可能被捕捉并实时传进共享的 VR 场景，观众用一体机头显观看，同时把同一场景投影给房间里的其他人。
works.exercise_en: Stream a phone-tracked performer's position into a shared WebXR scene as a simple glowing figure and let classmates watch it in headsets while the real performer moves in the same room. Twist: hide the performer behind a curtain and compare how present the avatar feels.
works.exercise_zh: 把用手机追踪的表演者位置实时传进共享的 WebXR 场景，表现为一个简单的发光人形，让同学戴头显观看，而真实的表演者就在同一房间里移动；变体：把表演者藏到幕布后，比较虚拟形象的在场感有何变化。

works.title: Between Information and Noise
works.description: A daily practice on dance and VR, recorded in 360° at the Akademie für Theater und Digitalität: Jorge dances among a seated audience while the virtual layer of the piece appears as projected light lines, and each session is shared as a 360 video.
works.description_zh: 在 Akademie für Theater und Digitalität 进行的一项舞蹈与 VR 日常练习，全程以 360° 录制：Jorge 在围坐的观众之间起舞，作品的虚拟层以投影光线的形式出现，每一次练习都作为 360 视频发布。
works.idea_en: Let the audience sit inside the dance and see both the body and its virtual trace at once.
works.idea_zh: 让观众坐在舞蹈之中，同时看到身体和它在虚拟空间中的痕迹。
works.technique: Likely a tracked VR headset or controllers feed his movement into a real-time 3D scene that is projected into the room, while a 360 camera records both layers from the centre.
works.technique_zh: 很可能用带追踪的 VR 头显或手柄把他的动作送入实时三维场景并投影到房间里，同时在中央架设 360 摄像机把两层画面一起记录下来。
works.exercise_en: Put a 360 camera in the middle of a circle of classmates and have a dancer draw light lines in a VR painting app that are projected on the wall behind them. Twist: rotate who wears the headset every minute.
works.exercise_zh: 在围坐的同学中间放一台 360 相机，让舞者在 VR 绘画应用里画出光线，同时投影到他们身后的墙上；变体：每分钟轮换一次戴头显的人。

works.title: Graphical Representation of Dance in VR (Motion Bank)
works.description: Applied research at Motion Bank in which dancers wear VR headsets to create and move through graphic, three-dimensional versions of dance scores, testing how choreographic notation could exist in space rather than on paper.
works.description_zh: 在 Motion Bank 进行的应用研究：舞者戴上 VR 头显，创建并穿行于图形化的三维舞谱之中，探索编舞记谱能否存在于空间里，而不只是纸上。
works.idea_en: A dance score you can step inside instead of read.
works.idea_zh: 一份可以走进去、而不是拿来读的舞谱。
works.technique: Dancers likely use a VR drawing tool to record their movement paths as 3D strokes, which then remain in the room as a spatial score for others to follow.
works.technique_zh: 舞者很可能用 VR 绘画工具把动作轨迹记录成三维笔触，这些笔触留在空间里，成为别人可以跟随的空间舞谱。
works.exercise_en: In a WebXR or phone AR drawing app, have one student trace a 20-second phrase with the controller, then ask another to dance it only by following the strokes. Twist: colour each stroke by speed.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 或手机 AR 绘画应用，让一名学生用手柄描出一段 20 秒的动作，再让另一名学生只看笔触把它跳出来；变体：按速度给每一笔上色。

works.title: Paper Classifier (openFrameworks + Wekinator)
works.description: Holding a sheet of paper in front of a webcam in five different ways triggers five different particle-system visuals, each with its own song.
works.description_zh: 拿着一张纸以五种不同方式出现在摄像头前，就会触发五种不同的粒子视觉效果，各自配一首歌。
works.idea_en: A plain piece of paper becomes a five-button controller once the camera learns its shapes.
works.idea_zh: 摄像头学会了纸的形状后，一张普通的纸就变成了有五个按钮的控制器。
works.technique: Webcam features are sent over OSC to Wekinator, which is trained on five classes of paper poses; the recognised class is sent back to an openFrameworks particle system that switches visuals and music.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头提取的特征通过 OSC 发给 Wekinator，训练它识别五类纸张姿态；识别结果再发回 openFrameworks 的粒子系统，切换画面和音乐。
works.exercise_en: Train Teachable Machine on three ways of holding a notebook and use each class to change a p5.js scene and sound. Twist: make the scene react only when two students hold their papers the same way.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Teachable Machine 训练三种拿笔记本的姿势，每一类切换一个 p5.js 场景和声音；变体：只有两名学生用同样方式举纸时场景才会响应。

works.title: Composition X
works.description: A sphere inside a pyramid inside a cube, after Kepler's model of the cosmos: ultrasonic sensors read how far each visitor stands, and several people moving around it mix the LED colours together while a mirrored centre opens into an infinite reflection.
works.description_zh: 立方体里套着金字塔，金字塔里套着球体，取自开普勒的宇宙模型：超声波传感器测量每位观众的距离，几个人围着它移动就能一起混合 LED 的颜色，而镜面中心则展开无限延伸的反射。
works.idea_en: Visitors mix the colour of the sculpture together just by where they stand.
works.idea_zh: 观众仅靠自己站的位置，就能一起调出雕塑的颜色。
works.technique: Ultrasonic distance sensors on each side feed a microcontroller that maps each visitor's distance to the LED colour channels, while two-way mirrors create the infinity effect.
works.technique_zh: 每一面的超声波测距传感器接到微控制器，把每位观众的距离映射到 LED 的颜色通道，双向镜营造出无限反射。
works.exercise_en: Build a cardboard lantern with three ultrasonic sensors and an addressable LED strip so each sensor controls red, green or blue by distance. Twist: the colour only turns white when all three people stand at the same distance.
works.exercise_zh: 用纸板做一个灯笼，装上三个超声波传感器和一条可寻址 LED 灯带，让每个传感器按距离分别控制红、绿、蓝；变体：只有三个人站在相同距离时颜色才会变白。

works.title: shemza.digital #5
works.description: A walk-through archway taken from Anwar Shemza's City Wall paintings, made in recycled green acrylic: as a visitor approaches, sensors make the arch light up and invite them to pass through it.
works.description_zh: 一座可以穿行的拱门，取自 Anwar Shemza 的 City Wall 系列画作，用回收绿色亚克力制成：观众走近时，传感器让拱门亮起，邀请人从中穿过。
works.idea_en: A painted arch becomes a real doorway that lights up to welcome you.
works.idea_zh: 画里的拱门变成真的门，会亮起来欢迎你。
works.technique: Ultrasonic sensors measure the visitor's distance and a bespoke circuit ramps up the LEDs inside the acrylic arch as they get closer.
works.technique_zh: 超声波传感器测量观众的距离，定制电路随着人靠近逐渐调亮亚克力拱门里的 LED。
works.exercise_en: Turn a classroom doorway into a threshold with a distance sensor and LED strip that brightens as someone approaches. Twist: make it fade out if two people try to pass at once.
works.exercise_zh: 用一个测距传感器和一条 LED 灯带把教室门口变成一道门槛，有人靠近就逐渐变亮；变体：如果两个人同时想穿过，灯就熄灭。

works.title: shemza.digital #8
works.description: Visitors scan a QR code, make their own digital painting in the style of Anwar Shemza on their phone, and send it to an ever-growing archive that animates on the gallery wall; made with Stuart Batchelor and Peter Todd.
works.description_zh: 观众扫描二维码，在手机上以 Anwar Shemza 的风格画一幅数字画，再把它提交到不断增长的档案中，档案在展厅墙上以动画形式播放；与 Stuart Batchelor 和 Peter Todd 合作。
works.idea_en: Every visitor's phone painting joins a shared, living wall in the gallery.
works.idea_zh: 每位观众在手机上画的画，都会汇入展厅里一面共享的、活的墙。
works.technique: A web painting app reached by QR code saves each submission to an online archive, and a real-time animation on the gallery screen pulls in the new paintings as they arrive.
works.technique_zh: 通过二维码打开网页绘画应用，每件作品都存进在线档案，展厅屏幕上的实时动画会把新到的画作即时加入。
works.exercise_en: Build a p5.js drawing page limited to three shapes and five colours that posts each drawing to a shared wall projected in class. Twist: each new drawing pushes the oldest one off the wall.
works.exercise_zh: 用 p5.js 做一个只允许三种形状、五种颜色的绘画网页，每幅画都会发送到课堂投影的共享墙上；变体：每来一幅新画，就把最旧的一幅挤出墙面。

works.title: Thanet Warn(m)ing
works.description: An immersive light and sound installation that wraps the viewer in coloured light and shifting audio driven by 60 years of temperature data from the Manston weather station in Thanet: the warmer the year, the warmer the colour and the louder the sound.
works.description_zh: 一件沉浸式光与声装置，用 Thanet 地区 Manston 气象站 60 年的气温数据驱动彩色灯光和起伏的声音，把观众包裹其中：年份越热，颜色越暖、声音越响。
works.idea_en: Stand inside sixty years of local warming, felt as colour and volume.
works.idea_zh: 站进本地六十年的变暖之中，用颜色和音量去感受它。
works.technique: Yearly temperature values are mapped to LED colour temperature and to the gain of a local field recording, played back in sequence as a timeline.
works.technique_zh: 把逐年气温映射到 LED 的色温和一段本地环境录音的音量上，按时间顺序依次播放。
works.exercise_en: Download your city's yearly temperature record and drive a phone flashlight colour app or an LED strip plus a sound loop from it, one year per second. Twist: let visitors scrub through the years by walking along a line on the floor.
works.exercise_zh: 下载你所在城市的逐年气温记录，用它驱动一条 LED 灯带（或手机屏幕颜色）和一段循环音，每秒走一年；变体：让观众沿地上的一条线行走来拖动年份。

works.title: Seconds Pass
works.description: A four-metre field of glowing spheres whose pulses follow live birth and death rates of children under five: four children are born every second and one dies every six seconds, commissioned by Save the Children, with lighting animation by Tim Murray-Browne.
works.description_zh: 一片四米见方的发光球体阵列，闪烁节奏跟随五岁以下儿童的出生率和死亡率：每秒有四个孩子出生，每六秒有一个孩子死去。由 Save the Children 委托，灯光动画由 Tim Murray-Browne 制作。
works.idea_en: A statistic becomes a heartbeat of light you cannot look away from.
works.idea_zh: 一个统计数字变成一阵让人无法移开目光的光之心跳。
works.technique: Addressable LEDs inside plastic spheres are animated by a timing program that fires a pulse for each birth and a dimming for each death at the real global rates.
works.technique_zh: 塑料球里的可寻址 LED 由计时程序驱动，按真实的全球比率为每一次出生点亮脉冲、为每一次死亡调暗灯光。
works.exercise_en: Pick a real per-second statistic and make a phone screen or LED strip pulse at exactly that rate on a table in the room. Twist: add a second rhythm for the opposite statistic and let the two beats drift against each other.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个真实的“每秒”统计数据，让桌上的手机屏幕或 LED 灯带严格按这个频率闪动；变体：再为相反的统计加入第二种节奏，让两个节拍相互错开。

works.title: Evolution of the Garden
works.description: A sound installation and performance at Athens Digital Arts Festival, made with Dimitra Kousteridou: touching potted plants wired into analogue and digital circuits adds voices to a growing soundscape.
works.description_zh: 在 Athens Digital Arts Festival 展出的声音装置与表演，与 Dimitra Kousteridou 合作：触碰连入模拟和数字电路的盆栽，就会给不断生长的声景加入新的声音。
works.idea_en: A garden you play by touching its leaves.
works.idea_zh: 一座靠触摸叶子来演奏的花园。
works.technique: Plants are connected to a Makey Makey and small analogue and digital circuits, so the body's touch closes a circuit that triggers or modulates sound through a mixer and speakers.
works.technique_zh: 植物连到 Makey Makey 以及几块小型模拟和数字电路上，人一碰就接通电路，经调音台和音箱触发或调制声音。
works.exercise_en: Wire three houseplants to a Makey Makey and map each to a sound loop in a browser sampler. Twist: a sound only plays while two people touch different plants and hold hands.
works.exercise_zh: 把三盆植物接到 Makey Makey 上，每盆对应浏览器采样器里的一段循环音；变体：只有两个人分别摸着不同植物并手拉手时声音才会响起。

works.title: Instrument for Dissonance
works.description: Motors swing ropes against suspended metal sheets in anxious, repeating loops; when a person enters, their position in the room shortens the loops and resets the rhythm.
works.description_zh: 电机甩动绳子，拍打悬挂的金属板，形成焦躁、重复的循环；当有人走进来时，他在房间里的位置会缩短循环，让节奏重新开始。
works.idea_en: A self-playing machine whose rhythm is interrupted by your presence.
works.idea_zh: 一台自己演奏的机器，节奏会被你的出现打断。
works.technique: A presence or distance sensor (likely) reads where the visitor stands and changes the timing of the motors that swing the ropes onto the metal sheets.
works.technique_zh: （很可能是）存在或测距传感器读出观众的位置，改变甩动绳子的电机的节拍。
works.exercise_en: Hang tin lids from a string, tap them with a servo on an Arduino in a steady loop, and let a distance sensor speed up the loop as someone approaches. Twist: the machine stops entirely if the visitor stands perfectly still.
works.exercise_zh: 用绳子挂起几个铁皮盖，用 Arduino 控制舵机按固定循环敲击，再用测距传感器让有人靠近时循环变快；变体：如果观众完全静止，机器就彻底停下。

works.title: Thermal Improvisations
works.description: An audiovisual performance at Goldsmiths that explores the thermal landscape of a space: a performer moves in front of a thermal camera whose heat image is projected, and the image shapes the improvised sound.
works.description_zh: 在 Goldsmiths 进行的一场视听表演，探索空间的热景观：表演者在热成像摄像头前移动，热图像被投影出来，并影响即兴的声音。
works.idea_en: Play the room with body heat that only a thermal camera can see.
works.idea_zh: 用只有热成像摄像头才看得见的体温，来演奏这个房间。
works.technique: A thermal camera feed is projected live and its temperature values are likely analysed in software to modulate sound in real time.
works.technique_zh: 热成像摄像头的画面实时投影，其温度数值很可能经软件分析后实时调制声音。
works.exercise_en: Clip a cheap phone thermal camera to a projector and project the live heat image; place a warm mug and ask students to leave handprints on the wall and watch them fade. Twist: map the hottest point's position to the pitch of a tone.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个便宜的手机热成像镜头接到投影仪上，投出实时热图；放一杯热水，请学生在墙上按手印并看它们慢慢消失；变体：把最热点的位置映射成一个音的音高。

works.title: Flowfal
works.description: At the Sónar+D exhibition in Barcelona, a visitor dances with a smartwatch on her wrist and her arm movements bend and trigger an Ableton sound in real time.
works.description_zh: 在巴塞罗那 Sónar+D 展览上，一位观众手腕戴着智能手表跳舞，她的手臂动作实时弯折并触发 Ableton 中的声音。
works.idea_en: Any phone or watch you already wear becomes a gesture instrument.
works.idea_zh: 你已经戴着的手机或手表，就能变成手势乐器。
works.technique: An app streams the device's orientation and acceleration over low-latency Wi-Fi to plug-ins in Ableton Live or Max, where each movement is mapped to parameters, MIDI notes or controllers.
works.technique_zh: 应用通过低延迟 Wi-Fi 把设备的姿态和加速度传给 Ableton Live 或 Max 里的插件，每个动作都能映射到参数、MIDI 音符或控制器。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone sensor-to-OSC app to send tilt data to a browser synth and let students dance a filter sweep. Twist: two phones, one controlling pitch and one controlling volume, so a duet is needed to play a melody.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机传感器转 OSC 的应用把倾斜数据发送给浏览器合成器，让学生用舞蹈扫出滤波变化；变体：两部手机，一部控制音高一部控制音量，必须两人合跳才能奏出旋律。

works.title: Smartwatch Theremin
works.description: Two ordinary Android watches approximate a theremin inside a Max patch: raising the right arm controls volume, rolling the left hand sets pitch and lifting the left arm adds vibrato.
works.description_zh: 两块普通的 Android 手表在 Max 程序里模拟出一台特雷门琴：抬起右臂控制音量，转动左手决定音高，抬起左臂加入颤音。
works.idea_en: Play an invisible theremin with two wristwatches.
works.idea_zh: 用两块手表演奏一台看不见的特雷门琴。
works.technique: Flowfal streams roll and pitch angles from each watch into a standalone Max patch, where arm angle maps to gain and wrist roll maps to oscillator frequency.
works.technique_zh: Flowfal 把每块手表的翻滚角和俯仰角传进独立的 Max 程序，手臂角度映射到音量，手腕翻转映射到振荡器频率。
works.exercise_en: Strap two phones to students' forearms and build a Web Audio theremin where one arm's angle is pitch and the other's is volume. Twist: snap the pitch to a pentatonic scale so the class can play a round together.
works.exercise_zh: 把两部手机绑在学生前臂上，用 Web Audio 做一台特雷门琴，一只手臂的角度决定音高，另一只决定音量；变体：把音高吸附到五声音阶上，让全班一起轮唱。

works.title: Pell Ensemble x handmadesound x Thunkist: Magnitogorsk R&D
works.description: Proof of concept for a spatial-sound, 360° film dance work about the industrial history of Magnitogorsk: with a smartwatch on each wrist, dancer Rebecca Evans triggers the music and moves it around a surround-sound space.
works.description_zh: 一部关于马格尼托哥尔斯克工业史的空间声音、360° 影像舞蹈作品的概念验证：舞者 Rebecca Evans 两只手腕各戴一块智能手表，由她触发音乐，并把声音在环绕声空间中移来移去。
works.idea_en: The dancer's arms place each sound in the room around the audience.
works.idea_zh: 舞者的手臂把每个声音摆放到观众周围的空间里。
works.technique: Flowfal watch data is mapped in Ableton Live to clip triggers and to the pan and position of surround channels, and the result is rendered binaurally for the 360 video.
works.technique_zh: 在 Ableton Live 中把 Flowfal 手表数据映射到片段触发以及环绕声道的声像位置，结果再渲染成双耳音频配合 360 视频。
works.exercise_en: Set up four speakers in the room corners and map a phone's compass heading to which speaker a loop plays from, so a dancer can throw sound around the class. Twist: add a second dancer whose sound always plays from the opposite corner.
works.exercise_zh: 在房间四角各放一个音箱，把手机的指南针方向映射为循环音从哪个音箱发出，让舞者把声音在教室里“甩”来“甩”去；变体：加入第二位舞者，他的声音总是从相对的角落传出。

works.title: Audience-Controlled Tracks at Totally Wired EMOM
works.description: At an electronic music open mic in Chorlton, musician Thunkist hands Flowfal devices to people in the pub so the audience's movements shape the track being played.
works.description_zh: 在 Chorlton 的一场电子音乐开放麦上，音乐人 Thunkist 把 Flowfal 设备交给酒吧里的观众，让观众的动作塑造正在播放的曲子。
works.idea_en: The crowd, not the performer, holds the controls.
works.idea_zh: 掌握控制权的是观众，而不是表演者。
works.technique: Several phones or watches running Flowfal stream motion to Ableton Live, where each device is mapped to a different layer or effect of the track.
works.technique_zh: 多部运行 Flowfal 的手机或手表把动作数据传给 Ableton Live，每台设备映射到曲子中不同的声部或效果。
works.exercise_en: Give four students phones that each control one layer of a web loop by shaking them, and let the room build the track together. Twist: a layer only plays while its phone is being passed from hand to hand.
works.exercise_zh: 发给四名学生每人一部手机，摇动手机分别控制网页循环曲的一个声部，让全场一起搭出一首曲子；变体：某个声部只有在手机被人传来传去时才会响。

works.title: Talking Trees of Chalkwell Park
works.description: An augmented reality trail in Southend's Chalkwell Park, commissioned by Metal: visitors find particular trees and, through their phones, meet them as characters who share the park's social history along with some frank opinions.
works.description_zh: 绍森德 Chalkwell Park 里的一条增强现实路线，由 Metal 委托：观众找到特定的树，通过手机与它们作为角色相遇，听它们讲公园的社会历史，外加一些直言不讳的看法。
works.idea_en: The park's trees become storytellers with a voice and a personality.
works.idea_zh: 公园里的树变成有声音、有个性的讲述者。
works.technique: A mobile AR app likely uses location or image triggers at each tree to overlay an animated character and play its recorded voice.
works.technique_zh: 手机 AR 应用很可能在每棵树旁用位置或图像触发，叠加动画角色并播放录好的配音。
works.exercise_en: Pick three trees on campus, write a short monologue for each from the tree's point of view, and anchor an animated face and audio to each with Lens Studio or an AR Foundation image marker. Twist: the trees disagree with each other about the same event.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园里选三棵树，以树的视角各写一段独白，用 Lens Studio 或 AR Foundation 的图像标记给每棵树锚定一张动画脸和一段语音；变体：让这几棵树对同一件事意见不合。

works.title: Portals for Mortals
works.description: An interactive takeover of a public sculpture with four doorways in Peterborough's Nene Park: walking through one doorway plays one part of a fanfare recorded by locals, and only passing through all four, usually as a group, plays the full fanfare and unlocks the next one.
works.description_zh: 对彼得伯勒 Nene Park 里一座有四个门洞的公共雕塑进行的互动改造：穿过一个门洞会奏响由当地人录制的号角曲中的一个声部，只有穿过全部四个门洞（通常需要一群人一起）才能奏出完整号角曲并解锁下一首。
works.idea_en: Walk through all four doorways together to play the whole fanfare.
works.idea_zh: 一起穿过四个门洞，才能奏出完整的号角曲。
works.technique: Sensors in each doorway detect a person passing and trigger that doorway's part of a four-part recording; a controller checks when all four have fired to advance to the next fanfare.
works.technique_zh: 每个门洞里的传感器检测有人经过，触发四声部录音中对应的一部分；控制器判断四个门洞都被触发后，切换到下一首号角曲。
works.exercise_en: Tape four cheap motion sensors to four classroom doorways or chair gaps, each triggering one layer of a song, and make the full song play only when all four fire within five seconds. Twist: the order of passing changes the arrangement.
works.exercise_zh: 在教室的四个门口或椅子间隙贴上四个便宜的运动传感器，每个触发歌曲的一个声部，只有五秒内四个都被触发时才播放完整歌曲；变体：穿过的顺序会改变编曲。

works.title: Play Table
works.description: A multi-player audiovisual table: an interactive image is projected from above onto a large tabletop, and people standing around its edge push virtual objects that collide and make sound in surround, sometimes cooperating and sometimes competing.
works.description_zh: 一张多人视听桌：互动画面从上方投影到大桌面上，围在桌边的人推动虚拟物体，让它们碰撞并在环绕声中发声，时而合作、时而竞争。
works.idea_en: A table where strangers play with the same projected objects from all sides.
works.idea_zh: 一张桌子，陌生人从四面八方一起摆弄同一批投影出来的物体。
works.technique: An overhead camera or depth sensor tracks hands at the table edge, and a physics simulation projected from above turns those contacts into collisions and spatialised sound.
works.technique_zh: 顶部摄像头或深度传感器追踪桌边的手，从上方投影的物理模拟把这些接触变成碰撞和空间化的声音。
works.exercise_en: Point a projector and webcam down at a table and build a p5.js physics sketch where hand shapes push balls that play notes when they hit each other. Twist: the balls only move when two hands from opposite sides touch them.
works.exercise_zh: 把投影仪和摄像头朝下对准一张桌子，用 p5.js 做一个物理草图：手的形状推动小球，小球相撞时发出音符；变体：只有桌子两侧的两只手同时碰到时小球才会移动。

works.title: Luminescence
works.description: When someone steps into the active zone in front of a large back-projected screen, an outline is drawn around them with swirling manga-like marks, and a fluxing energy thread links every person and object in the zone, building the soundtrack as more threads appear.
works.description_zh: 当有人踏进大型背投屏幕前的感应区，身体轮廓就会被勾勒出来，周围迸出漫画般的旋转笔触；感应区里的每个人和物体之间会连起一条跳动的能量线，线越多，配乐越浓烈。
works.idea_en: Energy threads connect everyone who steps into the frame.
works.idea_zh: 能量线把每个走进画面的人连接在一起。
works.technique: A Kinect infrared camera segments people and objects within a set depth range, and software draws outlines, motion-driven marks and threads between the detected blobs while their count drives the sound.
works.technique_zh: Kinect 红外摄像头在设定深度范围内分割出人和物体，软件为检测到的每个区块画出轮廓、随动作变化的笔触和彼此间的连线，同时用区块数量驱动声音。
works.exercise_en: Use a webcam and background subtraction in p5.js or TouchDesigner to find each person's blob and draw a line between every pair. Twist: lines snap when two people move too far apart.
works.exercise_zh: 在 p5.js 或 TouchDesigner 里用摄像头和背景减除找出每个人的区块，并在每两人之间画线；变体：两人离得太远时，线就会断开。

works.title: Electricus
works.description: Visitors see their outline surrounded by crackling electrical energy on a large screen; the bigger they move, the more intense the electricity looks and sounds.
works.description_zh: 观众在大屏幕上看到自己的轮廓被噼啪作响的电流包围；动作越大，电流的画面和声音就越强烈。
works.idea_en: Your movement charges your own body with electricity on screen.
works.idea_zh: 你的动作让屏幕上的自己充满电流。
works.technique: Camera-based motion detection measures the amount of movement around each silhouette and scales a lightning-style effect and sound to it.
works.technique_zh: 基于摄像头的动作检测测量每个轮廓周围的运动量，并据此放大闪电般的效果和声音。
works.exercise_en: In TouchDesigner or p5.js, use frame differencing to measure motion and draw jagged lines from the silhouette edge whose length follows that motion. Twist: the electricity jumps between two people when they almost touch.
works.exercise_zh: 在 TouchDesigner 或 p5.js 中用帧差法测量运动量，从轮廓边缘画出锯齿线，线长随运动量变化；变体：两个人几乎碰到时，电流会在两人之间跳跃。

works.title: Mirror Noise
works.description: Five two-minute interactive portrait studies across three screens: your outline becomes neon shapes, sparks shower where you move, recent frames scramble into a time warp, a clap or shout distorts your image, and streams of data flow around you.
works.description_zh: 分布在三块屏幕上的五段两分钟互动肖像：你的轮廓变成霓虹图形，你动的地方洒下火花，最近几帧画面被打乱成时间扭曲，一声拍手或喊叫会让你的影像变形，数据流绕着你流动。
works.idea_en: A mirror that answers your movement and voice with five different moods.
works.idea_zh: 一面镜子，用五种不同的情绪回应你的动作和声音。
works.technique: Three webcams feed edge and movement detection, with a microphone driving the distortion study and a frame buffer shuffling recent frames for the time warp.
works.technique_zh: 三台摄像头提供边缘与运动检测，麦克风驱动变形效果，帧缓存打乱最近的画面形成时间扭曲。
works.exercise_en: Build a webcam mirror that swaps between three effects every minute: edge neon, motion sparks and a sound-triggered stretch. Twist: let a loud clap skip to the next effect.
works.exercise_zh: 做一面摄像头镜子，每分钟在三种效果之间切换：边缘霓虹、动作火花和声音触发的拉伸；变体：大声拍手就跳到下一个效果。

works.title: Chaotic Body II: Liminal Phase
works.description: A motion-capture dance film for screen and augmented reality made with choreographer Alexander Whitley, in which the breath and movement of two dancers dissolve their bodies into flowing, chaos-theory-inspired forms.
works.description_zh: 与编舞家 Alexander Whitley 合作的动作捕捉舞蹈影片，面向屏幕与增强现实：两位舞者的呼吸和动作让身体消融成受混沌理论启发的流动形态。
works.idea_en: Breath dissolves the boundary between the dancers' bodies and their surroundings.
works.idea_zh: 呼吸溶解了舞者身体与周围环境之间的边界。
works.technique: Motion-capture data of the dancers drives real-time particle and fluid simulations in Unity whose behaviour follows chaotic attractor patterns.
works.technique_zh: 舞者的动作捕捉数据在 Unity 中驱动实时粒子和流体模拟，其运动遵循混沌吸引子的规律。
works.exercise_en: Record a short movement with a phone pose-tracking app and use the joint positions to drive a particle system in Lens Studio or three.js that is placed on the floor in AR. Twist: tie particle emission to the dancer's breathing rhythm.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机姿态追踪应用录下一小段动作，用关节位置在 Lens Studio 或 three.js 里驱动一个粒子系统，并以 AR 方式放在地面上；变体：让粒子的喷发跟随舞者的呼吸节奏。

works.title: PRE-FIGURES
works.description: A hybrid performance for BFI's Luminous event in which a live dance trio moves alongside dancers from the BFI national archive, whose flat film footage is reanimated as floating 3D figures on stage.
works.description_zh: 为 BFI 的 Luminous 活动创作的混合表演：现场三人舞与来自 BFI 国家档案馆的舞者同台，那些平面的影像资料被重新激活为舞台上漂浮的三维人形。
works.idea_en: Archive dancers step out of old film and share the stage with living ones.
works.idea_zh: 档案影像里的舞者走出老胶片，和活着的舞者同台共舞。
works.technique: Archive footage is passed through the MiDaS depth-estimation model inside Unity (via Barracuda), turning each frame into a displaced 3D surface that is rendered and projected in real time.
works.technique_zh: 档案影像在 Unity 中通过 Barracuda 运行 MiDaS 深度估计模型，把每一帧变成有起伏的三维曲面，并实时渲染投影。
works.exercise_en: Run a depth-estimation model on an old dance clip and display it as a point cloud in WebXR or phone AR next to a live classmate. Twist: let the live dancer copy the archive dancer with a two-second delay.
works.exercise_zh: 用深度估计模型处理一段老舞蹈片段，在 WebXR 或手机 AR 里把它显示为点云，放在现场同学身旁；变体：让现场舞者延迟两秒模仿档案里的舞者。

works.title: Motion-Reactive Physarum
works.description: A real-time simulated slime mould that grows its vein-like networks in response to movement, used to augment the Blessed Art Foundation's launch party.
works.description_zh: 一个实时模拟的黏菌，会根据人的动作生长出叶脉般的网络，用来为 Blessed Art Foundation 的发布派对增添视觉。
works.idea_en: A living slime mould that grows toward the people moving in front of it.
works.idea_zh: 一株会朝着眼前移动的人生长的“活”黏菌。
works.technique: A GPU agent-based Physarum simulation deposits and follows trails, and a motion input, likely from a camera, adds attractant where people move.
works.technique_zh: 在 GPU 上运行的 Physarum 智能体模拟会留下并追随痕迹，而运动输入（很可能来自摄像头）在人移动的地方加入“诱食剂”。
works.exercise_en: Adapt an open-source Physarum shader in TouchDesigner or p5.js so webcam motion adds food to the trail map, and project it on a wall. Twist: stillness makes the network slowly retreat.
works.exercise_zh: 在 TouchDesigner 或 p5.js 里改造一个开源的 Physarum 着色器，让摄像头捕捉到的运动向轨迹图中加入“食物”，再投影到墙上；变体：人一静止，网络就慢慢退缩。

works.title: Monolith
works.description: S+T+ARTS AIR residency project on whether a digital entity can perform alongside humans: a dancer's body, reconstructed from ordinary video, stirs a 3D fluid simulation in real time as part of a 'digital performer's brain'.
works.description_zh: S+T+ARTS AIR 驻留项目，追问数字实体能否与人同台表演：从普通视频中重建出的舞者身体，作为“数字表演者大脑”的一部分，实时搅动一个三维流体模拟。
works.idea_en: A dancer's body stirs a virtual fluid as if dancing in water.
works.idea_zh: 舞者的身体搅动虚拟流体，就像在水中起舞。
works.technique: GVHMR monocular human mesh recovery produces an SMPL body from video, and the per-vertex motion of that mesh is added to the velocity field of a real-time fluid simulation in Unity.
works.technique_zh: 用 GVHMR 单目人体网格重建从视频生成 SMPL 人体，再把网格每个顶点的运动叠加到 Unity 实时流体模拟的速度场中。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe pose on a webcam and inject each wrist's velocity into a 2D fluid shader projected on the floor. Twist: use the dancer's shadow instead of the skeleton as the obstacle.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头加 MediaPipe 姿态识别，把两只手腕的速度注入投在地面的二维流体着色器；变体：用舞者的影子而不是骨架作为流体的障碍物。

works.title: Protist Reverie
works.description: A one-off live full-dome performance at Athens Digital Arts Festival where their algorithmic slime-mould organism fills the dome and responds in real time to the improvised music of Saber Rider.
works.description_zh: 在 Athens Digital Arts Festival 上的一次性球幕现场演出：他们的算法黏菌生物布满整个穹顶，并实时回应 Saber Rider 的即兴音乐。
works.idea_en: A digital organism lives across the whole dome and breathes with live music.
works.idea_zh: 一个数字生物栖息在整个穹顶上，随现场音乐呼吸。
works.technique: A real-time Physarum-style simulation rendered in fisheye for dome projection takes audio analysis of the live set as input to its growth and colour.
works.technique_zh: 实时的 Physarum 式模拟以鱼眼方式渲染用于球幕投影，并把现场演奏的音频分析作为其生长和色彩的输入。
works.exercise_en: Render an audio-reactive particle sketch in a fisheye projection and project it onto an umbrella or a paper dome that students lie under. Twist: let one student's voice feed the organism while another's starves it.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个音频响应的粒子草图渲染成鱼眼投影，投到学生躺在下面的雨伞或纸穹顶上；变体：让一名学生的声音喂养这个生物，另一名学生的声音让它挨饿。

works.title: ZEROTIME
works.description: A light installation without light: visitors enter a dark, hazy room and use their phone torches to find their way through a grid of retroreflective tubes that bounce the light straight back, while a program turns the phones' light into a five-channel soundscape.
works.description_zh: 一件没有光的灯光装置：观众走进黑暗、弥漫雾气的房间，用手机手电筒在一排排回射反光管之间摸索前行，光线被直接反射回来；同时程序把手机的光转化为五声道声景。
works.idea_en: You only receive as much light as you shine into the room.
works.idea_zh: 你照进房间多少光，就只能得到多少光。
works.technique: Retroreflective tubes return each phone's torch beam toward its source through haze, and light sensors in the space feed an interactive framework that generates the sound.
works.technique_zh: 回射材料的管子穿过雾气把每部手机的光束反射回光源方向，空间中的光感应器把数据送入互动程序生成声音。
works.exercise_en: Darken a room, hang strips of retroreflective tape on strings and let students explore with phone torches while a light sensor on an Arduino changes a drone sound. Twist: give only one student a torch and let them guide the others.
works.exercise_zh: 把房间弄暗，在绳子上挂满回射反光胶带，让学生拿手机手电筒探索，同时用 Arduino 上的光感应器改变一段持续音；变体：只给一名学生手电筒，由他为其他人引路。

works.title: Reflector Suits
works.description: Unable to show a light work in a bright space without haze, the duo became the artwork: they stand still in public in patterned retroreflective suits that flare into light whenever a camera flash or headlight hits them, here on the streets of Shibuya.
works.description_zh: 因为展览场地明亮又不能用烟雾，无法展示灯光作品，这对艺术家干脆把自己变成作品：他们穿着印有图案的回射反光服静立在公共场所，一旦被相机闪光灯或车灯照到就会亮起，这里是在东京涩谷街头。
works.idea_en: Two living sculptures that only light up in other people's cameras.
works.idea_zh: 两座活雕塑，只在别人的镜头里才会发光。
works.technique: Retroreflective fabric bounces light straight back to its source, so the suits look plain to the eye but glow in any photo taken with flash.
works.technique_zh: 回射面料把光直接反射回光源，所以衣服肉眼看来很普通，但在任何开闪光灯拍的照片里都会发亮。
works.exercise_en: Cut shapes from retroreflective tape, stick them on clothing or a wall, and compare what people see directly with what appears in flash photos. Twist: hide a message that only shows in a flash photo.
works.exercise_zh: 用回射反光胶带剪出图形，贴在衣服或墙上，比较肉眼所见和闪光灯照片里的差别；变体：藏一条只在闪光照片中才会显现的信息。

works.title: Warping Halos
works.description: A large motorised, illuminated ring hangs from the ceiling and revolves through the space, shifting colour and intensity with a soundscape so the halo seems to warp and multiply around the viewers.
works.description_zh: 一个巨大的电动发光圆环从天花板垂下，在空间中旋转，颜色和亮度随声景变化，让光环仿佛在观众周围扭曲、倍增。
works.idea_en: A single spinning ring of light turns into a halo that bends the room.
works.idea_zh: 一只旋转的光环，变成一道能让整个房间弯曲的光晕。
works.technique: An LED ring on a motorised mount is rotated on several axes and sequenced with DMX lighting and sound, so persistence of vision and haze create ghost circles.
works.technique_zh: 装在电动支架上的 LED 圆环绕多个轴旋转，并与 DMX 灯光和声音同步编排，利用视觉暂留和雾气产生幻影光圈。
works.exercise_en: Attach an LED hoop to a slow rotating motor or a lazy Susan in a dark room and film it with long exposure on phones. Twist: change the rotation speed with the loudness of music.
works.exercise_zh: 在暗室里把 LED 圆环装在慢速旋转的电机或转盘上，用手机长曝光拍摄；变体：让旋转速度随音乐音量变化。

works.title: TRANSITO
works.description: A 50-metre light corridor made with the architects Space Encounters for Salone del Mobile in Milan: coloured waves of light travel along repeated frames, so the gallery seems endless and visitors feel carried forward by the light.
works.description_zh: 与建筑事务所 Space Encounters 为米兰设计周合作的一条 50 米光之走廊：彩色光波沿着重复的框架流动，让展厅看起来没有尽头，观众仿佛被光推着向前走。
works.idea_en: Waves of light make a corridor feel infinite and pull you along it.
works.idea_zh: 光波让走廊显得无穷无尽，并牵引你向前走。
works.technique: A row of LED frames along the corridor is sequenced as travelling waves of colour, using repetition and perspective to erase the sense of the room's length.
works.technique_zh: 沿走廊排列的一系列 LED 框被编排成流动的彩色光波，借助重复和透视消除对空间长度的感知。
works.exercise_en: Line a school corridor with ten phone screens or LED strips and program a colour wave that travels at walking speed. Twist: make the wave run against the walking direction and see how people's pace changes.
works.exercise_zh: 在学校走廊里排放十块手机屏幕或 LED 灯带，编排一道以步行速度流动的颜色波；变体：让光波逆着行走方向流动，观察人们的步速怎样变化。

works.title: Between Light
works.description: In the Gothic Oude Kerk in Amsterdam, a long, gently sagging line of light hangs in the empty nave and, over a 24-minute sequence, slowly rises and falls like a sunrise and sunset.
works.description_zh: 在阿姆斯特丹哥特式的 Oude Kerk 里，一条微微下垂的长光线悬在空旷的中殿中，在 24 分钟的循环里缓缓升起又落下，犹如日出日落。
works.idea_en: A single line of light becomes a horizon that rises and sets inside a church.
works.idea_zh: 一条光线化作地平线，在教堂里升起又落下。
works.technique: A suspended LED line on motorised winches is choreographed in height and brightness on a slow 24-minute cycle.
works.technique_zh: 悬挂的 LED 光条装在电动绞盘上，高度和亮度按 24 分钟的缓慢周期编排。
works.exercise_en: In phone AR, place a thin glowing line across a real room and animate it to rise and fall over five minutes while students sit and watch. Twist: tie the height of the line to the real sun's elevation at that moment.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 在真实房间里横放一条细细的发光线，让它在五分钟内缓缓升起再落下，学生坐着观看；变体：把光线的高度绑定到此刻真实太阳的高度角。

works.title: Pose Tracking R&D on the Aston Webb Building
works.description: Pose-tracking tests that use the University of Birmingham's Aston Webb Building as a canvas: people on the ground wave their arms and the projection on the facade reacts to their movement.
works.description_zh: 以伯明翰大学 Aston Webb 大楼为画布的姿态追踪测试：地面上的人挥动手臂，建筑立面上的投影随之做出反应。
works.idea_en: Wave your arms and a whole building moves with you.
works.idea_zh: 挥挥手臂，整栋楼就跟着你动。
works.technique: A camera with real-time pose estimation tracks a person's skeleton, and the joint data drives graphics that are mapped onto the scanned building facade.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头配合实时姿态估计追踪人的骨架，关节数据驱动映射到已扫描建筑立面上的图形。
works.exercise_en: Project onto the school building or a large wall and use MediaPipe pose in TouchDesigner so a student's arm angle opens and closes projected windows. Twist: the facade only reacts when three people strike the same pose.
works.exercise_zh: 把画面投到学校楼体或大墙上，在 TouchDesigner 里用 MediaPipe 姿态识别，让学生手臂的角度打开或关上投影出来的窗户；变体：只有三个人摆出相同姿势时立面才会响应。

works.title: Waterhall Mocap Performance
works.description: For the reopening of the Waterhall at Birmingham Museum and Art Gallery, Birmingham Royal Ballet dancers Reina Fuchigami and Shuailun Wu perform while their movement paints real-time motion-capture imagery on a screen; visitors could also try it with their own bodies.
works.description_zh: 为伯明翰博物馆与美术馆 Waterhall 重新开放而作：Birmingham Royal Ballet 的舞者 Reina Fuchigami 和 Shuailun Wu 表演时，他们的动作在屏幕上实时绘出动作捕捉影像；观众也可以用自己的身体来尝试。
works.idea_en: A dancer's limbs leave painted trails that hang in the air behind them.
works.idea_zh: 舞者的四肢在身后留下悬在空中的彩色轨迹。
works.technique: Real-time motion capture tracks the dancers' joints, and the joint paths are rendered as brush-like ribbons in a game engine and shown live on a large screen.
works.technique_zh: 实时动作捕捉追踪舞者的关节，关节轨迹在游戏引擎里被渲染成笔刷般的彩带，并在大屏幕上实时显示。
works.exercise_en: Use a webcam and MediaPipe to draw fading ribbons from a dancer's wrists and ankles on a projected screen, then invite the audience to try. Twist: each visitor's ribbons stay on screen until the next person replaces them.
works.exercise_zh: 用摄像头和 MediaPipe 从舞者的手腕和脚踝画出渐隐的彩带并投影出来，再邀请观众尝试；变体：每位观众的彩带都保留在屏幕上，直到下一个人把它们替换掉。

works.title: University of Birmingham 125th Anniversary Projection Show
works.description: A 13-minute projection-mapped show on the Aston Webb Building that seems to open the facade to reveal interior spaces such as the Great Hall and its stained glass, built on drone scans of the building and campus.
works.description_zh: 投影在 Aston Webb 大楼上的 13 分钟光影秀，仿佛打开了建筑外墙，露出 Great Hall 及其彩色玻璃窗等室内空间；整场演出建立在对大楼和校园的无人机扫描之上。
works.idea_en: A building's facade opens to show what is inside it.
works.idea_zh: 建筑的外墙打开，让人看见里面的空间。
works.technique: Drone photogrammetry creates a digital twin of the facade used to pre-visualise the show, and scanned interiors are rendered in perspective so they appear to sit behind the wall.
works.technique_zh: 用无人机摄影测量为立面建立数字孪生并预演整场秀，再把扫描得到的室内空间按透视渲染，使其看起来就在墙后。
works.exercise_en: Photograph a classroom wall, model it quickly in Blender, and project a fake cutaway revealing the room behind it. Twist: reveal what the wall looked like fifty years ago.
works.exercise_zh: 拍下一面教室墙，在 Blender 里快速建模，投影出一个假的剖切口，露出墙后的房间；变体：展示这面墙五十年前的样子。

works.title: Techno-Botanica
works.description: An AR artwork for Nocturnal at Electric Medway Festival 2024: through a phone, a night-time courtyard fills with glowing, neon alien plants that people can walk among.
works.description_zh: 为 Electric Medway Festival 2024 的 Nocturnal 活动制作的 AR 作品：透过手机，夜晚的庭院长满发光的霓虹外星植物，人们可以在其间穿行。
works.idea_en: A dark courtyard becomes a glowing alien garden on your phone.
works.idea_zh: 在手机里，昏暗的庭院变成一座发光的外星花园。
works.technique: Likely a mobile AR scene anchored to the ground plane, with emissive 3D plant models animated in a game engine.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是锚定在地面上的手机 AR 场景，用游戏引擎给自发光的三维植物模型做动画。
works.exercise_en: Model three glowing plants in Blender, place them in a Lens Studio or 8th Wall ground scene, and plant a garden outside at dusk. Twist: the plants only bloom when the phone's microphone hears singing.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Blender 里做三株发光植物，放进 Lens Studio 或 8th Wall 的地面场景，傍晚到室外种出一座花园；变体：只有手机麦克风听到有人唱歌时植物才会开花。

works.title: Tales of the Deep
works.description: An AR piece for Luton Lights 2025 in which a spectral pirate and deep-sea creatures swim into an ordinary community room through the visitor's phone.
works.description_zh: 为 Luton Lights 2025 创作的 AR 作品：透过观众的手机，一个幽灵海盗和各种深海生物游进一间普通的社区活动室。
works.idea_en: The sea floods an everyday room and brings its ghosts with it.
works.idea_zh: 大海淹没了一间普通房间，还带来了它的幽灵。
works.technique: Likely mobile AR with animated 3D characters and particle effects placed in the room using plane detection.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是手机 AR，利用平面检测把带动画的三维角色和粒子效果放进房间。
works.exercise_en: Place a swimming AR fish that follows the phone around the classroom, then add a larger creature that appears only in a dark corner. Twist: the water level rises the longer the room stays quiet.
works.exercise_zh: 放一条会跟着手机在教室里游动的 AR 鱼，再加一只只在暗角出现的大型生物；变体：房间越安静，水位涨得越高。

leads.name: Matt Clugston
leads.why: Creative director and motion-graphics artist behind the real-time mocap imagery in Holosphere's Waterhall performance and the University of Birmingham projection show.

leads.name: Job van Nuenen
leads.why: Built the interactive framework and sound for Children of the Light's ZEROTIME, where visitors' phone torches are turned into a live soundscape.

leads.name: Stuart Batchelor
leads.why: Computer artist who co-created the participatory shemza.digital painting apps and installations with Aphra Shemza.
